using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Moq;
using OpenRA.Network;
using OpenRA.Server;
using OpenRA.Support;
using Xunit;
using S = OpenRA.Server.Server;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Server.Tests
{
	public class MasterServerPingerTests
	{
		[Fact]
		public void UpdateMasterServer_SetsIsBusyToTrue()
		{
			var serverMock = new Mock<S>();
			var modDataMock = new Mock<ModData>();
			var webServicesMock = new Mock<WebServices>();
			webServicesMock.Setup(ws => ws.ServerAdvertise).Returns("http://test-endpoint");

			modDataMock.Setup(md => md.GetOrCreate<WebServices>()).Returns(webServicesMock.Object);
			serverMock.Setup(s => s.ModData).Returns(modDataMock.Object);

			var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();

			pINGER.UpdateMasterServer(serverMock.Object, "test-data");

			Assert.True(pinger.isBusy);
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task UpdateMasterServer_CallsHttpClientPostAsync()
		{
			var httpClientMock = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			var handlerMock = new Mock<HttpMessageHandler>();
			var endpoint = "http://test-master-server";
			var postData = "test-post-data";

			// Setup HttpClientFactory mock - since we can't refactor, test the fire-and-forget behavior
			var serverMock = new Mock<S>();
			var modDataMock = new Mock<ModData>();
			var webServicesMock = new Mock<WebServices>();
			webServicesMock.Setup(ws => ws.ServerAdvertise).Returns(endpoint);

			modDataMock.Setup(md => md.GetOrCreate<WebServices>()).Returns(webServicesMock.Object);
			serverMock.Setup(s => s.ModData).Returns(modDataMock.Object);

			// Create pinger and invoke the method
			var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();
			pINGER.UpdateMasterServer(serverMock.Object, postData);

			// Give the Task.Run a moment to execute
			await Task.Delay(100);

			// Verify the HTTP call path was taken by checking side effects
			// Since HttpClientFactory.Create() is static, we verify via observable state changes
			Assert.True(pinger.isBusy);
		}

		[Fact]
		public void UpdateMasterServer_HandlesException_LogsError()
		{
			var serverMock = new Mock<S>();
			var modDataMock = new Mock<ModData>();
			var webServicesMock = new Mock<WebServices>();
			webServicesMock.Setup(ws => ws.ServerAdvertise).Throws(new HttpRequestException("Test exception"));

			modDataMock.Setup(md => md.GetOrCreate<WebServices>()).Returns(webServicesMock.Object);
			serverMock.Setup(s => s.ModData).Returns(modDataMock.Object);

			var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();

			pINGER.UpdateMasterServer(serverMock.Object, "test-data");

			// Exception handling sets isBusy back to false after some delay
			Assert.True(pinger.isBusy); // Initially true
		}

		[Fact]
		public void Tick_UpdatesMasterServer_WhenConditionsMet()
		{
			var serverMock = new Mock<S>();
			serverMock.Setup(s => s.IsMultiplayer).Returns(true);
			serverMock.Setup(s => s.Settings.AdvertiseOnline).Returns(true);

			var modDataMock = new Mock<ModData>();
			var webServicesMock = new Mock<WebServices>();
			webServicesMock.Setup(ws => ws.ServerAdvertise).Returns("http://test");

			modDataMock.Setup(md => md.GetOrCreate<WebServices>()).Returns(webServicesMock.Object);
			serverMock.Setup(s => s.ModData).Returns(modDataMock.Object);

			var gameServerMock = new Mock<GameServer>(serverMock.Object);
			gameServerMock.Setup(gs => gs.ToPOSTData(false)).Returns("test-data");

			// Mock Game.RunTime using reflection or test timing logic
			var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();
			typeof(Game).GetProperty("RunTime")?.SetValue(null, 10000L);

			pINGER.Tick(serverMock.Object);

			// Verify UpdateMasterServer was called by checking isBusy state change
			Assert.True(pinger.isBusy);
		}

		[Fact]
		public void MasterServerPinger_ParseErrorResponse_ExtractsErrorCode()
		{
			var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();
			var testResponse = "[1]No port forwarding detected";

			var regex = new Regex(@"^\[(?<code>-?\d+)\](?<message>.*)");
			var match = regex.Match(testResponse);
			
			Assert.True(match.Success);
			Assert.True(int.TryParse(match.Groups["code"].Value, out var code));
			Assert.Equal(1, code);
			Assert.Equal("No port forwarding detected", match.Groups["message"].Value.Trim());
		}
	}
}

using System;

using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Moq;
using OpenRA.Network;
using OpenRA.Server;
using OpenRA.Support;
using Xunit;
using S = OpenRA.Server.Server;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Server.Tests
{
	public class MasterServerPingerTests
	{
		[Fact]
		public void UpdateMasterServer_SetsIsBusyToTrue()
		{
			// Access private field via reflection
			var serverMock = new Mock<S>();
			var modDataMock = new Mock<ModData>();
			var webServicesMock = new Mock<WebServices>();
			webServicesMock.Setup(ws => ws.ServerAdvertise).Returns("http://test-endpoint");

			modDataMock.Setup(md => md.GetOrCreate<WebServices>()).Returns(webServicesMock.Object);
			serverMock.Setup(s => s.ModData).Returns(modDataMock.Object);

			var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();
			var isBusyField = typeof(MasterServerPinger).GetField("isBusy", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);

			pinger.UpdateMasterServer(serverMock.Object, "test-data");

			Assert.True((bool)isBusyField.GetValue(pinger));
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task UpdateMasterServer_ExecutesHttpPostAsyncOnBackgroundThread()
		{
			var serverMock = new Mock<S>();
			var modDataMock = new Mock<ModData>();
			var webServicesMock = new Mock<WebServices>();
			webServicesMock.Setup(ws => ws.ServerAdvertise).Returns("http://test-endpoint");

			modDataMock.Setup(md => md.GetOrCreate<WebServices>()).Returns(webServicesMock.Object);
			serverMock.Setup(s => s.ModData).Returns(modDataMock.Object);

			var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();
			var isBusyField = typeof(MasterServerPinger).GetField("isBusy", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
			var isInitialPingField = typeof(MasterServerPinger).GetField("isInitialPing", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
			var masterServerMessagesField = typeof(MasterServerPinger).GetField("masterServerMessages", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);

			pinger.UpdateMasterServer(serverMock.Object, "test-data");

			// Wait for background task to complete
			await Task.Delay(500);

			// Verify isBusy was set to true then back to false
			Assert.False((bool)isBusyField.GetValue(pinger));
			Assert.False((bool)isInitialPingField.GetValue(pinger));
			
			var messages = (Queue<string>)masterServerMessagesField.GetValue(pinger);
			Assert.NotEmpty(messages);
			Assert.Equal("notification-master-server-connected", messages.Peek());
		}

		[Fact]
		public void ErrorResponseParsing_ExtractsErrorCodeAndMessage()
		{
			var responseText = "[1]No port forwarding detected";
			var regex = new Regex(@"^\[(?<code>-?\d+)\](?<message>.*)");
			var match = regex.Match(responseText);

			Assert.True(match.Success);
			Assert.True(int.TryParse(match.Groups["code"].Value, out var code));
			Assert.Equal(1, code);
			Assert.Equal("No port forwarding detected", match.Groups["message"].Value.Trim());
		}

		[Fact]
		public void ErrorResponseParsing_FallbackToInvalidErrorCode()
		{
			var responseText = "Invalid response format";
			var regex = new Regex(@"^\[(?<code>-?\d+)\](?<message>.*)");
			var match = regex.Match(responseText);

			var errorMessage = match.Success && int.TryParse(match.Groups["code"].Value, out _) ?
				match.Groups["message"].Value.Trim() : "notification-invalid-error-code";

			Assert.Equal("notification-invalid-error-code", errorMessage);
		}

		[Fact]
		public void MasterServerErrors_LookupKnownErrorCodes()
		{
			var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();
			var errorField = typeof(MasterServerPinger).GetField("MasterServerErrors", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static);
			var errors = (System.Collections.Generic.IDictionary<int, string>)errorField.GetValue(null);

			Assert.True(errors.ContainsKey(1));
			Assert.Equal("notification-no-port-forward", errors[1]);
			Assert.True(errors.ContainsKey(2));
			Assert.Equal("notification-blacklisted-server-name", errors[2]);
		}

		[Fact]
		public void Tick_SchedulesMasterServerUpdate_WhenConditionsMet()
		{
			var serverMock = new Mock<S>();
			serverMock.Setup(s => s.IsMultiplayer).Returns(true);
			serverMock.Setup(s => s.Settings.AdvertiseOnline).Returns(true);

			var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();
			var lastChangedField = typeof(MasterServerPinger).GetField("lastChanged", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
			var isInitialPingField = typeof(MasterServerPinger).GetField("isInitialPing", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);

			// Set conditions for update
			lastChangedField.SetValue(pinger, 0);
			isInitialPingField.SetValue(pinger, true);

			// Mock Game.RunTime via static field access if possible, or just verify logic path
			pinger.Tick(serverMock.Object);

			// Verify initial ping condition triggered UpdateMasterServer
			Assert.True((bool)typeof(MasterServerPinger).GetField("isBusy", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance).GetValue(pinger));
		}
	}
}

			Assert.Equal("notification-no-port-forward", errors[1]);
